study_type: exploratory transfer, lambda chosen after inspecting NRF-04 test data

sources.checkpoint_cohort: the exact twelve frozen tied ToyLoop checkpoints
sources.model_weights: unchanged, SHA-256 checked by NRF-03 loader
sources.task_definition: signed permutation tanh, first 8 teacher outputs, fixed source task seeds 101,103,107
sources.projection_construction: Identical train-only 8D supervised, shifted and eight random arms from NRF-04

folds.generator: same LCG32/Box-Muller integer recipe, fold indices included in seed as in NRF-04

objective.comparator: median across all eight complete random-arm objective values, at same lambda
objective.constraints: Calculate each random-arm task MSE and leakage from the same arm before taking median

endpoints.primary: At exposure 4096, R16 supervised objective beats random-median in at least 5 of 6? (Three seeds only; threshold at least 3/3 for R16, at most 0/3 for R32)
endpoints.planned_expectation: R16: supervised wins 3/3 final seed cells; R32: random median wins 3/3 final seed cells
endpoints.secondary: paired exposure 2048 to 4096 change, first-eight baseline, label-shift null
endpoints.success_requires: All six final seed-depth cells evaluated with independent folds and verified original checkpoint hashes

interpretation: Replicates a depth-dependent combined-objective ranking on new examples for already-selected models and lambda; not an independently registered discovery of lambda or causal model improvement.
